in_sanskrit.name: Kopil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Tortoise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kopil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kopila' which means 'little tortoise'. This name is believed to signify strength, determination, and a connection to nature, particularly the water element.

This name is believed to signify strength, determination, and a connection to nature, particularly the water element.
